x: Apart from our quarter-miles we have none in action - save Graham Worrell, who defeated last year's Junion Champion John Strachan in the quarter-mile against Old Rutlishians.
Graham Worrell (24.2) and Pat Cornelius (24.8) were 3rd and 4th in the furlong, whilst Dave Mitchell (2:6.2) and F. Paget (2:12.0) took 5th and 7th places in the 880 yds.

Graham Worrell was also in fine fettle and in beating Paul Ellis of Poly he won the 'quarter' in 50.7. Others worthy of mention were Smithers (220 - 23.9, L.J. 19'9") Cornelius (220- 24.0 100 - 10.7), Don Maclean, Laurie O'Hara and Dave Baines.
